children: Fletcher Building has made a solid start to FY27 against low expectations, says Forsyth Barr. Analyst Rohan Koreman-Smit notes consensus expectations for FY27 are for 1% revenue growth in Light Building Products, 1% growth in Heavy Building Materials, and a 2% improvement in Distribution. "We remain early in the year, and the comparable periods clearly get harder from here, but the market may be overly cautious on the impact of the general election and rising mortgage rates, at least in the short term," Forsyth Barr says. It has an outperform call on Fletcher, which is down 1.5% at 3.30 New Zealand dollars. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
